posts.name: Diljit Dosanjh
posts.caption: Diljit paid tribute to Punjabi music legends before his Madison Square Garden show, crediting Chamkila, Gurdas Maan and others. His Imtiaz Ali film 'Main Vaapas Aaunga' releases June 12.

posts.name: Alia Bhatt
posts.caption: YRF drops the Alpha teaser on June 10 — Alia and Sharvari star as elite assassins in the first female-led YRF Spy Universe film, releasing July 3.

posts.name: Deepika Padukone
posts.caption: Deepika flaunted her baby bump at her new ₹119 crore Bandra home with Ranveer. The couple is expecting their second child after daughter Dua.

posts.name: Ranveer Singh
posts.caption: Riding high on Dhurandhar's ₹1,800 crore worldwide gross, Ranveer is gearing up for 'Pralay,' a ₹300 crore post-apocalyptic zombie thriller under his own banner.

posts.name: Shah Rukh Khan
posts.caption: SRK's 'King' is shooting with a massive ensemble including Deepika, Abhishek Bachchan and Suhana Khan. Confirmed for Christmas 2026 release with a ₹350 crore budget.

posts.name: Rashmika Mandanna
posts.caption: Newlywed Rashmika shared adorable Japan honeymoon photos with husband Vijay Deverakonda. She's now shooting Cocktail 2 with Shahid Kapoor and Allu Arjun's AA22xA6.

posts.name: Ram Charan
posts.caption: Ram Charan's Peddi crosses ₹200 crore India gross in just 5 days, dominating the box office. The Buchi Babu Sana-directed sports drama topped UK charts at #1.

posts.name: Priyanka Chopra
posts.caption: Priyanka confirms six months of shooting remain for SS Rajamouli's ₹1,300 crore epic 'Varanasi' with Mahesh Babu, including a historic Antarctica schedule.

posts.name: Shraddha Kapoor
posts.caption: Shraddha's biographical drama 'Eetha' locks August 28 release — she portrays legendary Tamasha artist Vithabai Narayangaonkar in her most challenging role yet.

posts.name: Kareena Kapoor Khan
posts.caption: Kareena weighed in on the Peddi controversy, saying 'sensuality has nothing to do with revealing clothes.' She's also in talks for Salman Khan's superhero film with Raj & DK.

posts.name: Vijay Thalapathy
posts.caption: Vijay's political party TVK won 108 seats in Tamil Nadu elections in a blockbuster debut. His final film 'Jana Nayagan' is now a cultural event awaiting release.

posts.name: Katrina Kaif
posts.caption: Ali Abbas Zafar confirms a Bollywood superhero universe starting with Katrina's film, followed by a reimagined Mr. India and two more characters.

posts.name: Allu Arjun
posts.caption: Allu Arjun's mega project 'Raaka' with director Atlee is shaping up as the biggest Indian film ever — a VFX-heavy sci-fi spectacle with multiple roles, eyeing 2027 release.

posts.name: Varun Dhawan
posts.caption: Varun's 'Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai' — dad David Dhawan's final directorial — is now in theaters. The rom-com also stars Pooja Hegde and Mrunal Thakur.

posts.name: Janhvi Kapoor
posts.caption: Janhvi's portrayal in Ram Charan's Peddi has sparked a major debate on objectification and the male gaze in Indian cinema, with industry veterans weighing in.

posts.name: AR Rahman
posts.caption: AR Rahman performed at the iconic Attari Border on June 7 in a tribute to BSF personnel, ahead of Imtiaz Ali's 'Main Vaapas Aaunga' release on June 12.

posts.name: Jr NTR
posts.caption: Jr NTR and Prashanth Neel's highly anticipated 'Dragon' is locked for a June 2027 release, promising mass mayhem and stylized gritty action.

posts.name: Samantha Ruth Prabhu
posts.caption: Samantha's 'Maa Anti Bangaram' releases June 19 — she plays a housewife with a fighter's spirit. Her comment during the Peddi controversy also went viral.

posts.name: Hrithik Roshan
posts.caption: Hrithik is making his directorial debut with Krrish 4, bringing Priyanka Chopra back as the female lead. The superhero saga is being produced by YRF and Rakesh Roshan.

posts.name: Kiara Advani
posts.caption: Kiara's first look as Nadia in Yash's gangster epic 'Toxic: A Fairy Tale for Grown-Ups' was unveiled. The film's release has been rescheduled for a bigger global rollout.

posts.name: Ananya Panday
posts.caption: Ananya's romantic musical 'Chand Mera Dil' with Lakshya released last month under Dharma Productions. She's been turning heads with her ethnic fashion game.

posts.name: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan
posts.caption: The former Miss World has been keeping a low profile amid Abhishek Bachchan's busy schedule with SRK's King. Fans eagerly await her next project announcement.

posts.name: Shreya Ghoshal
posts.caption: The playback queen continues her US concert tour with sold-out shows across major cities. Shreya remains Bollywood's most in-demand female vocalist in 2026.
